title: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
detail: UNIFIL said a patrol near Wadi Jilu in southern Lebanon came under fire on the evening of 10 November: about a dozen rounds were fired, the patrol returned fire after spotting a muzzle flash, and no peacekeepers were injured. UNIFIL did not name the shooter, called the attack a violation of UNSCR 1701 and urged the Lebanese government to investigate. UNIFIL's mandate expires 31 December 2026.
